title: 第29章 八级妖兽？
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
青云宗每次秘境大比都是第一名。

    这本不是什么稀奇事，也不会引起太多关注。

    各大宗门和修真世家争夺的是第二名和第三名，这自然是他们更多关注的地方。

    但是，顾念念跳到第一名的时候，这个延续了多年的关注被顷刻间剥夺了。

    所有人的目光都落在石碑最顶端，青云宗顾念念这六个字上面。

    顾念念是谁？

    这个问题现在问出来，怕是比问任何一个修士天阙宗宗主是谁，还要能更快得到答案。

    青云宗宗主顾衍亲去凡界接回来的女儿，母亲是谁无人知晓。

    但修真界无人不知，顾念念被带回青云宗的第一天测试就被天道石亲批是个废物。

    可才过了三个月，这个废物却出现在天渊秘境里，还一举压过了所有宗门和世家的天骄，直接冲上了第一名。

    一时之间，青云宗的飞舟被无数修士踏破铁鞋。

    智源大长老收到的拜访多到排不过来。

    他们纷纷来打听，这个顾念念到底是真的废物，还是青云宗为了掩盖其逆天的修炼才能，而编造出来的假话。

    而被人关注的顾念念，此时正被萧易寒背着往山谷里继续探进。

    与此同时，天渊秘境的另一层，星元脸上也已经彻底失去了笑容。

    他收敛起了惯有的散漫，冷着脸，御剑直接朝着顾念念所在的方向前进。

    而他的另一只手里，正捏着一张引魂符。

    “萧易寒，你冷吗？”

    萧易寒低头，看着顾念念有些发白的嘴唇，随后重新牵起了她的手。

    源源不断的热量从他的手心传来，最后传入全身。

    顾念念圆圆的小脸蛋又再次红润了起来。

    “这里灵气稀薄，注意运转灵力覆盖全身，可以让你保持身体温度不变。”

    顾念念照做。

    不一会儿，她惊喜地抬头。

    “真的不冷了。”

    也就是在这个时候，顾念念才注意到，周围的雾气很浓，其中还夹杂着一股说不上来的腥甜的气息。

    顾念念立马捂住口鼻。

    “这个味道好奇怪！”

    其实不奇怪，顾念念以前闻过，不止一次。

    这是血的味道。

    可除了刚刚萧易寒杀掉的几个人，根本就没有其他人了。

    萧易寒握紧了顾念念的手，眸光里多了一丝难测的谨慎。

    这么浓郁的血腥气，绝对不是几个人或几头兽能产生的。

    “小师叔，让你那两个小帮手出来。”

    顾念念立刻将桃夭和小六放了出来。

    这俩一出来，立刻拉响了自身的警报。
content_en:
Qingyun Sect ranked first in every secret realm competition.

    This is nothing unusual and doesn't attract much attention.

    The major sects and cultivation families are competing for the second and third places, which is naturally where they pay more attention.

    However, when Gu Niannian jumped to the first place, the attention that had lasted for many years was taken away in an instant.

    Everyone's eyes fell on the top of the stone tablet, the six words "Qingyun Sect Gu Niannian".

    Who is Gu Niannian?

    If you ask this question now, you will probably get the answer faster than if you ask any monk who the leader of the Tianque Sect is.

    Gu Yan, the head of the Qingyun Sect, went to the mortal world to pick up his daughter. No one knew who the mother was.

    But no one in the cultivation world knew that Gu Niannian was personally criticized by Tiandao Stone on the first day he was brought back to the Qingyun Sect for testing.

    But only three months later, this loser appeared in the Tianyuan Secret Realm, and in one fell swoop he overcame all the geniuses from sects and aristocratic families, and shot straight to the number one spot.

    Suddenly, the flying boat of Qingyun Sect was trampled by countless monks.

    Grand Elder Zhiyuan received so many visits that he couldn't even schedule them.

    They all came to find out whether Gu Niannian was really a waste, or whether it was a lie made up by the Qingyun Sect to cover up his incredible talent in cultivation.

    At this time, Gu Niannian, who was attracting attention, was being carried by Xiao Yihan as he continued to explore into the valley.

    At the same time, on the other level of Tianyuan Secret Realm, Xingyuan's face had completely lost his smile.

    He calmed down his usual laxity, with a cold face, and moved his sword directly in the direction of Gu Niannian.

    In his other hand, he was holding a soul attracting talisman.

    "Xiao Yihan, are you cold?"

    Xiao Yihan lowered his head, looked at Gu Niannian's somewhat white lips, and then held her hand again.

    A steady stream of heat came from the palm of his hand, and finally spread to the whole body.

    Gu Niannian's round little face turned rosy again.

    "The spiritual energy here is thin. Pay attention to the spiritual energy covering the whole body, which can keep your body temperature constant."

    Gu Niannian did as he was told.

    After a while, she looked up in surprise.

    "It's really not cold anymore."

    It was at this time that Gu Niannian noticed that the surrounding fog was very thick, mixed with an indescribable fishy-sweet smell.

    Gu Niannian immediately covered her mouth and nose.

    "This tastes so weird!"

    In fact, it's not surprising. Gu Niannian has smelled it before, more than once.

    This is the taste of blood.

    But except for the few people Xiao Yihan killed just now, there was no one else at all.

    Xiao Yihan held Gu Niannian's hand tightly, with an unpredictable caution in his eyes.

    Such a strong bloody smell cannot be produced by a few people or a few beasts.

    "Uncle Junior, let your two little helpers come out."

    Gu Niannian immediately released Taoyao and Xiaoliu.

    As soon as these two came out, they immediately sounded their own alarm.
